description: Main source file for sensor data collection and display on SensorTile.box Pro, including sensor configuration, data fetching, and output loop.

methods.name: lps22df_config
methods.description: Configures the LPS22DF sensor, sets sampling frequency, and optionally sets trigger handler.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_config
methods.description: Configures the LSM6DSV16X sensor, sets accelerometer and gyroscope sampling frequencies and full scales, and sets triggers if enabled.

methods.name: lis2mdl_config
methods.description: Configures the LIS2MDL magnetometer sensor, sets sampling frequency, and trigger if enabled.

methods.name: lis2du12_config
methods.description: Configures the LIS2DU12 accelerometer sensor, sets sampling frequency, and trigger if enabled.

methods.name: led_pattern_out
methods.description: Outputs a LED pattern sequence to indicate start of sensor test.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing sensors, configuring them, and entering an infinite loop to fetch, display sensor data, and print trigger counts.
